location.note: Winery point on Highway 29 (987 St. Helena Hwy). The vineyard is next to the winery; its outline is not mapped here yet.

soil.note: Reported from the soil maps Cathy Corison used when choosing the site. The USDA soil survey polygon under the vineyard has not been checked yet (SSURGO is blocked from the build sandbox).

claims.text: Kronos Vineyard lies between Rutherford and St. Helena.
The vines were planted in 1971 on St. George rootstock and are farmed organically.
Cathy Corison bought the property in 1995 after looking for Bale gravelly loam, the alluvial soil of the Rutherford Bench.
Owner recollection: loam, gravel and clay, with an ancient river crossing the property.
